description: In repos/relevance-sink-vessel/src/index.ts, make the GET /health handler verify the vessel's SurrealDB dependency instead of returning ok unconditionally. Perform a cheap authenticated probe to `${SURREALDB_URL}/sql` (body `RETURN 1;` with the same surreal-ns/surreal-db/Authorization headers applyPenalty already builds) with a timeout of about 2 seconds; when the probe succeeds return the existing 200 {status:"ok", vessel:"relevance-sink-vessel"}; when it fails return HTTP 503 with {status:"degraded", vessel:"relevance-sink-vessel", store:"unreachable"}. Reason: this vessel's health currently reports ok while every write fails ConnectionRefused — a miswired deployment (store absent or SURREALDB_URL pointing at nothing) passes every automatic health check; verified experimentally on 2026-09-15 (validation/reports/wiring-green-vs-miswired-proof). Health must reflect the one dependency the vessel exists to write to.
